thread:
Marta Nunez: @here heads-up: Sales escalated a FinAlpha request — after the quantized model rollout they saw intermittent timeouts on Dedicated (p95 spikes ~2.5s -> 6s). Customer asks for a fix within 48h. Can we triage?
Liam Chen: Do we have repro traces? Replay from their token logs?
Support: Jane: I attached logs in the ticket. It reproduces on their cluster during sustained burst traffic. No immediate errors in runtime logs, just longer tail latency.
Samir Patel: Sounds like batching/kv cache warmup. Could be quantization kernel fallback under tail load. Need a quick binary patch?
Jade Rivera: Two paths: 1) fastpath hotfix (small runtime change + config) -> canary and rollback, or 2) include in next weekly release (safer, longer QA). Customer wants 48h.
Marta Nunez: If hotfix, we need SRE + QA signoff, canary at 5% for 1h, then 25% for 2h. Also update sales comms. Who owns?
Liam Chen: I can own runtime patch with Samir. ETA 8-12h to produce candidate.
Samir Patel: I'll run perf benches and micro-regressions. Need test vectors from Support.
Support: Jane: Sent reduced repro set and their traffic profile (burst every 30s).
Jade Rivera: I'll draft comms for FinAlpha and internal comms: - what changed, rollback plan, expected user impact, contact for escalation.
Marta Nunez: Ops Bot: create a fastpath release ticket and link to customer ticket.
Ops Bot: Created ticket RINF-4521 (fastpath hotfix) and linked to FIN-3042.
Liam Chen: For canary: propose route policy to steer 5% traffic to hotfix model variant in their Dedicated pool. Need infra to apply routing.
Samir Patel: Also add a temporary bypass: disable continuous batching for <=128 tokens for that pool to see if it stabilizes tail. That change is config-only.
Jade Rivera: Comms note: if canary looks good, we offer to keep hotfix for 7 days then fold into next stable release. Need legal/contract signoff for any SLA credits.
Marta Nunez: Decision: proceed with hotfix fastpath. Owners: Liam (runtime patch), Samir (perf/bench), Jade (comms), SRE (canary ops). Timeline: candidate in 12h, canary in 18-20h, full rollout 36-48h if green.
Support: Jane: I'll tell FinAlpha we're moving on fastpath and give tentative timeline.
Liam Chen: pushing initial branch now: `git push origin hotfix/quant-fallback-finalpha`
Samir Patel: Running bench harness now. Early signal: local tail improves ~30% on repro. Will post numbers.
Jade Rivera: Drafted customer note, pinging legal for SLA blurb.
Ops Bot: Canary started for RINF-4521 at 5% for cluster finalpha-dedicated-3.
Marta Nunez: Everyone add monitoring dashboard widgets (latency p50/p95/p99, error rate, tokens/sec) to the ticket.
Samir Patel: Canary signals: p95 dropped from 6s -> 2.1s, no errors. Increasing to 25% now.
Liam Chen: Rolling to 25%. Watch for CPU/GPU load and KV cache miss rate.
Support: Jane: FinAlpha says latency looks improved on their end, monitoring OK.
Jade Rivera: Sending customer comms update now.
Marta Nunez: If any regression during 25% -> immediate rollback to previous runtime variant and notify FinAlpha.
Ops Bot: Canary at 25% complete, no anomalies.
Liam Chen: Filing PR for the hotfix branch, requesting quick review from Eng-Runtime.
Samir Patel: Bench full run finished, artifacts attached to RINF-4521.
Marta Nunez: Great work. Post-mortem follow-up: add a perf test to our release gate to catch this class of tail latency issue. Assign to Eng-ML.
Jade Rivera: Will include rollback and comms checklist in the ticket for next time.
Support: Jane: Closing loop with FinAlpha and scheduling follow-up next week. :thumbsup:
Marta Nunez: Thanks team — keep updates in this thread and the release ticket.
